question: Dhanush missile is a naval version of ______ missile.  (RRB JE (29/05/2019) Shift 3 CBT 1)
options: Akash
Agni
Nag
Prithvi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Prithvi

Explanation:
Dhanush missile is the naval version of the Prithvi missile. It is a surface-to-surface missile used by the Indian Navy. The Dhanush missile has a range of approximately 350 km and can carry a 500 kg warhead. It is developed based on the Prithvi-II missile. Dhanush can be launched from ships and coastal defense systems. It is part of India's Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme.

☛ Type of Dhanush missile → Surface-to-surface
☛ Warhead capacity of Dhanush → 500 kg

question_hi: धनुष मिसाइल ______ मिसाइल का एक नौसेना संस्करण है। (RRB JE (29/05/2019) Shift 3 CBT 1)

question: EKS Kosmos 2510 is the first satellite having early warning system launched by - (RRB JE CBT I (31/05/2019) Shift 1)
options: Russia
India
USA
Japan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Russia

Explanation:
EKS Kosmos 2510 is the first satellite equipped with an early warning system launched by Russia. It is part of Russia's EKS (Unified Space System) series, designed to detect and warn against missile attacks. The satellite was launched in 2015 and strengthens Russia's space-based early warning capabilities. The EKS system consists of a network of satellites in low Earth orbit capable of detecting ballistic missile launches. It replaces the older Oko system and is equipped with highly sensitive sensors.

question: Which of the following is an 'Air to Air Missile'? (RRB JE CBT I (02/06/2019) Shift 3)
options: Astra
Trishul
Maitri
Akash
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Astra

Explanation:
Astra is an Air-to-Air Missile developed by India. It is a supersonic missile with a range of about 80-110 km, capable of engaging enemy aircraft. Among the other options, Trishul and Akash are Surface-to-Air Missiles, while Maitri is a joint India-France project for a Surface-to-Air Missile. question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी 'हवा से हवा में मार करने वाली मिसाइल' है? (RRB JE CBT I (02/06/2019) Shift 3)

त्रिशूल
मैत्री
आकाश
solution_hi:

Explanation:

question: Which of the following two organisations teamed up to develop India’s first indigenous CAR-T cell therapy? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: IIT Bombay and IIT Madras
IIT Delhi and AIIMS Delhi
IIT Ropar and PGI Chandigarh
IIT Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is IIT Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre

Explanation:
India's first indigenous CAR-T cell therapy was developed jointly by IIT Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre. This therapy is named NexCAR19. It is a major breakthrough in cancer treatment. CAR-T therapy involves genetically modifying a patient's own T-cells to recognize and destroy cancer cells. This technology is particularly effective in treating blood cancers such as B-cell lymphoma and leukemia. This development makes India self-reliant in the field of CAR-T therapy and will reduce treatment costs.

☛ Full form of CAR-T therapy → Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell therapy
☛ Organizations that developed NexCAR19 → IIT Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre
☛ Which cell is used in CAR-T therapy → T-cell
☛ CAR-T therapy is mainly used to treat which disease → Blood cancers (B-cell lymphoma/leukemia)

question: In Aditya - L1, the first Indian mission to study the Sun, what does L1 stand for?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/03/2021) Shift 1)

The mission aims to study the Sun's corona, solar wind, and magnetic field. Lagrangian points are positions where the gravitational pull of two large bodies balances. There are five such points, and L1 is the most famous. Aditya-L1 is the first Indian mission dedicated to observing the Sun.
